notes.title: 1.8.4 - TransmissiON
notes.content:
[h2]New levels[/h2]
A new set consisting of [u]5 levels[/u] featuring new gameplay elements:
- 2 new player movements (Slide, Snake);
- 3 new player actions (Blink, Switch, Push);
- 1 new enemy (Hunter).

Completion of this level set will award [b]TransmissiON[/b] achievement.

[i]This level set assumes familiarity with basic game mechanics, so please complete [b]BOOT Camp[/b] if you haven't yet, but it's not required for the achievement unlock.[/i]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a deadlock bug in Reactor.
- Fixed Checkpoint not remembering Player's orientation.
- Fixed Hunter's area particle effect destruction.
- Fixed Zoom interaction if assigned and current values are the same.

[h3]Farewell[/h3]
This is the last update. The game is done. Thanks for playing!

- Added various simple sounds across game objects & their interactions. (Finally!)
- Improved theme settings to support the creation of multiple theme profiles and easy switching between them.
- Added 7 new themes as a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906150/Sharp__Theme_Pack/]free DLC[/url].
- Big thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mwyner/recommended/889530/]Mike Wyner[/url] for reporting a game-breaking bug related to Trap cell's erroneous behavior after killing a unit. This should be fixed now.

- Added hidden achievement.
- Fixed bug requiring app restart for an achievement to be triggered (I hope).
- Entrance no longer has description.
- Reworked BOOT Camp map layout.

- Fixed bug breaking Unit movement after using Portals.
- Editor highlight now follows theme colors.
- Adjusted grain effect.

- Fixed action related bugs.
- Adjusted player's cooldown effect.
- Added grain effect to video settings.

- Added Action cell with 4 actions: Base, Switch, Blink, Push.
- Now Checkpoint saves Player's action, cooldown, movement and transition.

- Changed editor highlight texture.
- Fixed bug on renaming Set.
- Fixed camera movement inertia after Player death resulting in prompts going off screen.

- Several minor visual effect adjustments.
- Added ability to rotate Player.
- Minor layout improvements to Input settings.
- Collections are now called Sets.

- The game now supported only on x64 systems.
- Added an achievement for completing "BOOT Camp" collection.

- Fixed Zoom cell texture.
- Portal now instantly moves camera on Player.
- Fixed Player input buffering order.

- Added VSync setting.
- Added TargetFPS setting.

[list]
[*] Fixed camera bug.
[*] Changed Entrance on mouse animation.
[*] Optimizations.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Camera systems optimizations.
[*] Changed camera tilting behavior from changing position to changing rotation.
[*] Now camera tilting is enabled in the Editor.

[*] Added visual feedback on mouse interactions for Entrance cell.
[*] Improved Zoom cell texture and animation.
[*] Fixed incorrect default zoom value for Zoom cell.
[*] Fixed wrong default effect state for Barrier cell.

[*] Now Properties.json is being synced via SteamCloud. Note, that you need to apply modifications to it while the game is running.
[/list]

[h1]Movement[/h1]
- Updated icons.

[h1]Player[/h1]
- Assigned movement's icon is now being displayed.
- Updated particle effects.

[h1]Hunter[/h1]
- Now always shifts out when moving.
- Minor update to texture.
- Updated particle effects.

[h1]Watcher[/h1]
- Updated particle effect.

[h1]Entrance[/h1]
- Updated particle effects.
- Added ability to zoom camera on Home scene.

- Added scale to Launcher cell
- Added transition to Movement cell
- Added screen fade transition between scenes

- Various visual improvements
- Various optimizations

[h1]Movement cell[/h1]
- Changed color scheme
- Adjusted particle effect

[h1]Added Movement cell[/h1]
This cell can modify [b]Player[/b]'s movement behaviour. There are 3 movement modifiers: [b]Base[/b], [b]Snake[/b] and [b]Jump[/b].

[h1]Updated Entrance cell[/h1]
Added support for [b]description[/b], multiple [b]connections[/b] and availability [b]threshold[/b]. 

[h1]Collection UI[/h1]
[b]Collection[/b] progression percentage is no longer displayed. Instead there will be a check symbol next to title when all the levels passed. 

[h1]Misc[/h1]
- Improved [b]Player[/b] movement input buffering.
- Adjusted [b]Player[/b] particle effects.

- Optimized [b]Collection[/b] loading.
- Selected [b]Collection[/b] and [b]Entrance[/b] are being saved now.

[h1]A compatibility note[/h1]
Due to changes to the build file hierarchy, existing progress will not be read, unless you manually move all Meta files from [i]Collections/Meta/[/i] to [i]Collections/[/i]. Sorry for the inconvenience.
